{{Infobox character|name=Old Ferrin|house=[[House Ironvale]]|role=Eldest master, retired|age=~70+}}
'''Old Ferrin''' has presented nothing new in twenty years, which in [[Forge Gap]] is a kind of death. He claims he once built something that captured the inexplicable — and destroyed it after a single use. No one believes him. The drawing is not in the Drafting Hall.
